title: Everyday life
description: Family, food and drinks, prices, time, and finding your way around the city.

lessons.title: Family
lessons.tip: Northern words: bố (father), mẹ (mother). anh / chị = older brother / sister, em = younger sibling; add trai (male) or gái (female): em trai, em gái.

items.vi: Bố mẹ tôi sống ở Hải Phòng.
items.en: My parents live in Hải Phòng.
alt: My parents live in Hai Phong.

items.vi: Tôi có một anh trai và một em gái.
items.en: I have an older brother and a younger sister.
alt: I have one older brother and one younger sister.
I have a big brother and a little sister.

items.vi: Chị gái tôi đã lấy chồng.
items.note: lấy chồng = (a woman) gets married; lấy vợ = (a man) gets married.

items.vi: Bạn có anh chị em không?
alt: Do you have brothers and sisters?
Do you have any brothers or sisters?

items.vi: Ông bà tôi sống ở quê.
items.en: My grandparents live in the countryside.
alt: My grandparents live in the village.
My grandparents live in their hometown.
items.note: quê = home village, hometown, the countryside.

items.vi: Con gái tôi rất thông minh.

alt: Do you have a wife yet?
items.note: Literally “Do you have a wife yet?” – a very common question. Answers: Tôi có vợ rồi / Tôi chưa có vợ.

alt: I do not have children yet.
I don't have any children yet.

items.vi: Gia đình bạn có mấy người?
items.en: How many people are in your family?
alt: How many people are there in your family?

lessons.title: Drinks
lessons.tip: Cho tôi … = … please (when ordering). Hanoi favourites: cà phê sữa đá (iced milk coffee), trà đá (iced tea), cà phê trứng (egg coffee), bia hơi (fresh draught beer). Northern: cốc = glass, cup.

items.vi: Cho tôi một cà phê sữa đá.
alt: Give me an iced milk coffee.
Give me one iced milk coffee.

items.en: What do you want to drink?
alt: What would you like to drink?

items.en: I want to drink iced tea.
alt: I would like to drink iced tea.
Give me a glass of water.
Give me a glass of water, please.

items.vi: Cà phê ở đây rất ngon.
items.en: The coffee here is very good.
alt: The coffee here is very delicious.
The coffee here is really good.

items.vi: Bạn đã thử cà phê trứng chưa?
items.en: Have you tried egg coffee yet?

alt: I like to drink orange juice.

items.en: A glass of draught beer, please!
alt: A glass of draft beer, please!
items.note: nhé at the end makes a request softer and friendlier.

lessons.title: Food
lessons.tip: ăn = to eat, ngon = tasty. Northern dishes: phở, bún chả, bánh mì, nem rán (fried spring rolls). chưa? at the end asks “… yet?”; answer rồi (already) or chưa (not yet).

items.en: The fried spring rolls are so good!
alt: The spring rolls are so good!
The fried spring rolls are so tasty!
The fried spring rolls are so delicious!
items.note: nem rán is the Northern name (Southern: chả giò).

items.vi: Tôi muốn ăn cơm với gà.
items.en: I want to eat rice with chicken.
alt: I would like rice with chicken.

items.vi: Mẹ tôi nấu ăn rất giỏi.
alt: My mother is a very good cook.

lessons.title: At the restaurant
lessons.tip: Call the staff with em ơi! (to someone younger), or anh ơi / chị ơi. Ask for the bill with Tính tiền! Northern: bát = bowl, đũa = chopsticks.

items.vi: Em ơi, cho anh xem thực đơn.
items.en: Excuse me, can I see the menu?
alt: Excuse me, may I see the menu?
Excuse me, let me see the menu.
items.note: ơi calls someone. Here a man (anh) talks to a younger waiter (em).

items.vi: Cho tôi hai bát phở bò.
items.en: Two bowls of beef phở, please.
alt: Give me two bowls of beef phở.
Two bowls of beef pho, please.
Give me two bowls of beef pho.

items.vi: Cho tôi thêm một đôi đũa.
alt: Give me another pair of chopsticks.
One more pair of chopsticks, please.
How much is it in total?
It was very good, thank you!

lessons.title: Prices
lessons.tip: Bao nhiêu tiền? = How much? nghìn = thousand, trăm = hundred. Prices in đồng are said in thousands: ba mươi nghìn (30,000). Northern: cân = kilo. Too pricey? Đắt quá!

items.vi: Bớt cho tôi một chút được không?
items.en: Can you lower the price a bit?
alt: Can you give me a small discount?
Can you make it a bit cheaper?
Could you lower the price a little?
Do you have any small change?

items.vi: Hai quả xoài giá bao nhiêu?
alt: How much do two mangoes cost?

items.vi: Tôi trả bằng thẻ được không?
alt: Can I pay with a card?

lessons.title: Time and days
lessons.tip: Mấy giờ? = What time? hôm nay (today), ngày mai (tomorrow), hôm qua (yesterday). Weekdays are numbered: thứ hai (Monday) … thứ bảy (Saturday), chủ nhật (Sunday).

items.vi: Bây giờ là ba giờ chiều.
items.en: It is three in the afternoon now.
alt: It's three in the afternoon now.
Now it is three in the afternoon.
I will go to work tomorrow.
Tomorrow I will go to work.
I am going to work tomorrow.

items.vi: Chủ nhật bạn có rảnh không?
Tôi dậy lúc sáu giờ sáng.
items.en: I get up at six in the morning.
alt: I wake up at six in the morning.

items.en: See you at seven in the evening!
alt: Let's meet at seven in the evening!

items.vi: Tuần sau tôi đi Đà Nẵng.
items.en: Next week I am going to Đà Nẵng.
alt: I am going to Đà Nẵng next week.
I'm going to Đà Nẵng next week.
Next week I'm going to Da Nang.
I'm going to Da Nang next week.
Next week I go to Đà Nẵng.
Next week I'm going to Đà Nẵng.

lessons.title: Places in the city
lessons.tip: ở = at, in. đi + place = go to a place, no word for “to” needed: Tôi đi chợ = I go to the market. đang = right now.

alt: I am going to the market.

items.vi: Tôi đang ở quán cà phê.
alt: I am at a coffee shop.

items.vi: Nhà tôi ở gần hồ Hoàn Kiếm.
items.en: My house is near Hoàn Kiếm Lake.
alt: My home is near Hoàn Kiếm Lake.
My house is near Hoan Kiem Lake.
My home is near Hoan Kiem Lake.

items.vi: Gần đây có nhà vệ sinh không?
items.en: Is there a toilet near here?
alt: Is there a restroom near here?

items.vi: Ngân hàng ở bên cạnh bưu điện.
items.en: The bank is next to the post office.
alt: The bank is beside the post office.

items.en: I want to go to the supermarket.
alt: I would like to go to the supermarket.
I'd like to go to the supermarket.

items.vi: Trường học ở đối diện công viên.
items.en: The school is opposite the park.
alt: The school is across from the park.

lessons.title: Directions
lessons.tip: rẽ trái = turn left, rẽ phải = turn right, đi thẳng = go straight (Northern rẽ; Southern quẹo). ngã tư = crossroads. … thì … = when …, then ….

alt: Go straight and then turn left.
Go straight ahead, then turn left.

items.vi: Đến ngã tư thì rẽ phải.
Xin lỗi, ga Hà Nội ở đâu?
items.en: Excuse me, where is Hanoi Station?
alt: Excuse me, where is Hà Nội Station?
Excuse me, where is Hanoi railway station?

items.vi: Không xa lắm, chỉ năm phút đi bộ.
items.en: Not very far, just a five-minute walk.
alt: Not very far, only five minutes on foot.
Not too far, just five minutes walking.
Not very far, only a five-minute walk.

items.vi: Hiệu thuốc ở bên phải đường.
items.en: The pharmacy is on the right side of the street.
alt: The pharmacy is on the right of the street.
The pharmacy is on the right side of the road.
items.note: hiệu thuốc = pharmacy in the North (Southern: nhà thuốc).

items.vi: Bạn có thể chỉ đường cho tôi không?
items.en: Can you show me the way?
alt: Could you show me the way?

items.vi: Đi qua cầu rồi đi thẳng.
items.en: Cross the bridge, then go straight.
alt: Go over the bridge and then go straight.
Cross the bridge and go straight.
Cross the bridge and then go straight.

lessons.title: Transport
lessons.tip: đi + vehicle = travel by: đi xe máy (by motorbike), đi xe buýt (by bus), đi tàu (by train), đi máy bay (by plane), đi bộ (on foot). bằng = by, with.

items.vi: Tôi đi làm bằng xe máy.
items.en: I go to work by motorbike.
alt: I get to work by motorbike.
I go to work by scooter.
I go to work by motorcycle.

items.note: à at the end: a surprised question to check something.

items.vi: Xe buýt số mười đi đâu?
items.en: Where does bus number ten go?
alt: Where does the number ten bus go?
Where does the number 10 bus go?

items.en: I want to call a taxi.
alt: I would like to call a taxi.
I'd like to call a taxi.
I want to get a taxi.

items.vi: Cho tôi đến sân bay Nội Bài.
items.en: Take me to Nội Bài Airport, please.
alt: Take me to Noi Bai Airport, please.
Take me to Nội Bài Airport.

items.vi: Tàu đi Sài Gòn mấy giờ chạy?
items.en: What time does the train to Saigon leave?
alt: When does the train to Saigon leave?
What time does the train to Sài Gòn leave?
What time does the train to Saigon depart?

items.vi: Tôi đi máy bay đến Huế.
alt: I go to Huế by plane.

items.vi: Đường này hay bị tắc lắm.
items.en: This road often has traffic jams.
alt: There are often traffic jams on this road.
items.note: tắc (đường) = traffic jam in the North (Southern: kẹt xe). hay = often.

lessons.title: Weather
lessons.tip: trời = sky, weather: trời nóng (it's hot), trời lạnh (it's cold), trời mưa (it's raining). Hanoi has four seasons: mùa xuân, mùa hè, mùa thu, mùa đông.

items.en: The weather is so nice today!
alt: The weather is so beautiful today!
Today the weather is so nice!

items.vi: Mùa đông ở Hà Nội rất lạnh.
items.en: Winter in Hanoi is very cold.
alt: Winter in Hà Nội is very cold.
In Hanoi winter is very cold.
Winters in Hanoi are very cold.

items.vi: Ngày mai trời có mưa không?
alt: Is it going to rain tomorrow?

items.vi: Mùa hè ở đây nóng lắm.
alt: It is very hot here in summer.
It's very hot here in summer.

items.en: It is humid and damp today.
items.note: nồm: the damp, misty weather of a Hanoi spring, when walls and floors get wet.

alt: Don't forget to bring an umbrella.
items.note: ô = umbrella in the North (Southern: dù).

items.vi: Trời lạnh, mặc áo khoác vào!
items.en: It's cold, put on a jacket!
alt: It is cold, put on a jacket!
It's cold, put a jacket on!
It's cold, put on your jacket!
It's cold, put on a coat!

items.vi: Hôm nay ba mươi lăm độ.
